Greece Takes Its Bailout, but Doubts for the Region Persist
headlines.abstract: The bailout by the International Monetary Fund and Greece’s European partners calls for as much as $146 billion in loans over the next three years.

headlines.title: Greece Takes Bailout, but Doubts for Region Persist
headlines.abstract: Greece announced on Sunday that it had reached agreement on a long-delayed financial rescue package that would require years of painful belt-tightening, but the deal might not be enough to stop the spread of economic contagion to other European countries with mounting debts and troubled economies.
